_what: Provenance test on the eqlwiki pages supplied for the MAKE ME BIS non-gear axis.
_method: eqlwiki.com/api.php action=query prop=revisions, oldest and newest. Two disqualifying tests from CLAUDE.md: oldest revision predates the EQ Legends launch of 2026-07-28, or the oldest editor carries an `imported>` / `P99Wiki>` prefix.

pages.title: Call of Flame
pages.note: THE SPELL PAGE, and the one that carries every figure. Self-labelled {{Classic Era}}. Newest revision is 2026-07-27, ONE DAY BEFORE LAUNCH. No post-launch edit exists.

call_of_flame_figures_verbatim._source: eqlwiki Call of Flame, wikitext at 2026-08-31T20:20Z, page tier 5, no post-launch revision
call_of_flame_figures_verbatim.description: Hurls a magically burning arrow at your target, causing 300 damage.

finding: The owner's recalled figures and the wiki's figures are THE SAME FIGURES. 300 damage and 0.50 cast appear verbatim on a page whose oldest editor is `imported>Doujou` (2020) and whose newest revision predates launch by one day. They are one source, not two, so the page cannot corroborate the recollection. The second half of the recollection -- ~0.125s under an empowering or inversion stance -- appears NOWHERE: the page has no stance interaction of any kind.
what_would_settle_it: A client spell-description window for Call of Flame on a level-49 Ranger in EverQuest Legends, and a measured cast time under the named stance.
